presentation.name: Define what belongs in each medallion layer, on any platform
presentation.summary: Sets what bronze, silver and gold each hold and must not hold, how data moves between them safely, and where quality checks sit, for Fabric, Databricks, plain Spark or dbt.
benefits: Keeps bronze a replayable copy of what arrived, so a logic fix is recomputed rather than re-pulled from the source
Makes every write between layers safe to re-run, so retries and backfills do not duplicate rows
Puts blocking checks in silver and business-rule checks in gold, where a failure stops the fewest consumers
Says when three layers are more than the pipeline needs
Covers Fabric lakehouse versus warehouse, OneLake shortcuts, Unity Catalog, and how the layers map onto dbt
